in_marathi.name: Jagatguru
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The Teacher of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagatguru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagatguru is a title given to a spiritual master who is considered to be the teacher of the world. It is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'jagat' meaning 'world' and 'guru' meaning 'teacher'. This title is given to those who have attained a high level of spiritual knowledge and are capable of guiding others towards the path of enlightenment.
